$edges.render -> core: Renderer.h: FrameStats field type; Renderer.cpp: m_stats.frame, m_stats.cpuMs; Mesh.h: Component base, GOLDEN_COMPONENT expansion, Component and StaticTypeId<T> call in the generated TypeId
$edges.render -> streaming: Renderer.h: TextureStreamer in the constructor declaration and the m_streamer field; Renderer.cpp: TextureStreamer in the constructor definition, m_streamer.RequestLoad

$edges.streaming -> io: TextureStreamer.h: IoQueue in the constructor declaration and the m_queue field, FileHandle field; TextureStreamer.cpp: IoQueue in the constructor definition, m_lastHandle.id, m_queue.Submit
$edges.streaming -> render: TextureStreamer.cpp: GpuUploader type and the GpuUploader::Upload call (render.backend): the undeclared dependency that closes the cycle
